prompt.project_info: A warm outdoor beauty portrait with softly observed garden detail and a natural golden-hour halo.
prompt.main_subject: Close-up of an adult woman with long wavy blonde hair, a calm direct gaze, soft pink lipstick, defined lashes, and both hands gently framing her face. She wears a golden-yellow satin high-neck top with softly ruched long sleeves.
prompt.composition_elements: Eye-level vertical portrait, face centered, hands supporting the jawline, shoulders and sleeves visible in the lower frame. Keep a softly blurred lawn, dark hedge, and understated pale architectural line behind her; omit text, logos, and graphic marks.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Low warm sun from behind-left at approximately 3800K gives the hair a halo and leaves soft contour shadows on the face. Retain natural skin texture, flyaway hairs, gentle bokeh, and a quiet late-summer atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Full-frame camera with an 85mm lens at f/2, vertical 3:4 crop, sharp focus on the eyes, creamy background falloff, Kodak Portra 400-inspired color, subtly lifted blacks, and restrained film grain.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Photorealistic cinematic close-up portrait of an adult woman with long wavy blonde hair, calm direct gaze, natural makeup with soft pink lipstick and defined lashes, resting her face gently in both hands, wearing a golden-yellow satin high-neck long-sleeve top with ruched sleeves. Outdoors in a garden or park with softly blurred greenery and a pale architectural element, warm golden-hour backlight creating a halo around her hair, eye-level portrait, sharp focus on eyes, soft shadows, natural skin texture, vertical 3:4 framing, no text or branding.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, logo, readable text, extra fingers, deformed hands, distorted eyes

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: An approved adult identity reference is optional and must preserve face, hair color, and age clarity. A wardrobe reference is optional for the yellow high-neck satin top. Keep the face-framing hand pose, warm backlight, and garden bokeh consistent; identity, plant species, and pale architectural backdrop may be replaced.
